_doc: Steve 2026-10-15: combat must not be the only viable route to good gear. These are starting levers, measured in gear-usage audits. No passive day/wave unlock for broadcast mastery or trade; food-powered gifts never replace dinner.
_lootRoutes: Lootabilities Arm 1 (2026-10-31): every lootTier item in items.json belongs to at least one named earnable route. extraItems = the PRIZE pool membership (contest prizes, broadcast gifts, trade — consulted by rollAlienLoot only on rewardSource paths, and by alienPlayers gift grants); it now lists EVERY non-alien lootTier item at its tier (alien-origin items are members of every pool by origin). killItems = the KILL pool membership beyond alien origin: what a carcass can plausibly carry (worn armor, trophies, ammunition, beast-touched gear), consulted by rollAlienLoot on monster kills. Ruin scavenge (regions.json) and crafting carry the rest. Reference scan (scripts/proof-lootabilities-w1.js scan): 0 unreachable lootTier items.
